030        public static enum ShipPickMode {
031                IMPORTED,
032                ALL,
033                PRIORITY_THEN_ALL,
034                PRIORITY_ONLY,
035        }
036        public static class ShipPickParams implements Cloneable {
037                public ShipPickMode mode;
038                public int maxFP = 1000;
039                public Long timestamp = null;
040                public Boolean blockFallback = null;
041                
042                public ShipPickParams(ShipPickMode mode, int maxFP, Long timestamp, Boolean blockFallback) {
043                        this.mode = mode;
044                        this.maxFP = maxFP;
045                        this.timestamp = timestamp;
046                        this.blockFallback = blockFallback;
047                }
048                public ShipPickParams(ShipPickMode mode, int maxFP, Long timestamp) {
049                        this.mode = mode;
050                        this.maxFP = maxFP;
051                        this.timestamp = timestamp;
052                }
053                public ShipPickParams(ShipPickMode mode, int maxFP) {
054                        this(mode, maxFP, null);
055                }
056                public ShipPickParams(ShipPickMode mode) {
057                        this(mode, 1000);
058                }
059                public ShipPickParams() {
060                        this(ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL, 1000);
061                }
062                @Override
063                public ShipPickParams clone() {
064                        try {
065                                return (ShipPickParams) super.clone();
066                        } catch (CloneNotSupportedException e) {
067                                return null;
068                        }
069                }
070        
071                public static ShipPickParams all() {
072                        return new ShipPickParams(ShipPickMode.ALL);
073                }
074                public static ShipPickParams priority() {
075                        return new ShipPickParams(ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL);
076                }
077                public static ShipPickParams imported() {
078                        return new ShipPickParams(ShipPickMode.IMPORTED);
079                }
080        }
